authority_note: GENERATED PROJECTION of MASTER_ACCEPTANCE_REGISTRY.json. Do not edit independently.

gates.title: Capture Reality Baseline
gates.requirement: Create docs/convergence/CURRENT_BASELINE.json generated from real inspection classifying each claim as CONFIRMED, FALSIFIED, UNVERIFIED, or INACCESSIBLE.
gates.acceptance_criteria: CURRENT_BASELINE.json records git branch, head SHA, remote SHA, test counts, migration head, active generation, and provider health.

gates.title: One Certification Control Plane
gates.requirement: Eliminate split-brain certification. Active control plane must be docs/convergence/. Legacy .flycheap files must not remain active authority.
gates.acceptance_criteria: All active scripts and tests read from docs/convergence/ rather than .flycheap/. No dual authority.

gates.title: Remove Hard-Coded Certification Values
gates.requirement: Eliminate hard-coded target SHA, test counts, migration counts, prewritten PASS outcomes, and score=10 by construction.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Certification artifacts are generated from actual command and test execution rather than literal constants.

gates.title: Fundamental Rewrite of Artifact Generator
gates.requirement: Fix lint failure in scripts/generate-convergence-artifacts.mjs and rewrite the generator to derive values dynamically.
gates.acceptance_criteria: generate-convergence-artifacts.mjs runs cleanly with 0 lint errors and computes counts dynamically.

gates.title: Dynamic Test Counts From Runner Output
gates.requirement: Test counts must come from actual test runner outputs (Vitest, Node --test, Deno test, Playwright).
gates.acceptance_criteria: No hard-coded test totals in certification artifacts.

gates.title: Dynamic Migration Count & Head
gates.requirement: Migration count and head must be computed dynamically by inspecting supabase/migrations/.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Actual file count and latest migration file name are dynamically detected.

gates.title: Dynamic Git SHA Resolution
gates.requirement: Current Git SHA must come dynamically from git rev-parse HEAD.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Release manifest and certification artifacts reflect actual git HEAD.

gates.title: Dynamic Deployment Identity Verification
gates.requirement: Deployment identity must come from deployed runtime/metadata endpoints.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Probe queries https://farely.manhtx.com/release.json and observed-fares release_sha live.

gates.title: Gate-Derived Readiness Score
gates.requirement: Final readiness score must be derived mathematically from gate states; no manually typed 10/10.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Scorecard computes readiness percentage based on proven P0, P1, and P2 gates.

gates.title: Registry Integrity Test
gates.requirement: Automated integrity test proving that all mandatory REQ-*, NC-*, and JOURNEY-* IDs from this prompt exist in the registry.
gates.acceptance_criteria: scripts/registry-integrity.node-test.mjs passes and fails closed if any ID is removed or priority weakened.

gates.title: Uncertified Source Mutation Prevention
gates.requirement: Uncertified source code must never mutate production runtime or data.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Production deployment and crawlers only run on verified, certified commits.

gates.title: Remove Crawler From Ordinary Push Trigger
gates.requirement: Remove production crawler mutation from ordinary push trigger in .github/workflows/fast-flights-pipeline.yml.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Crawler runs only on schedule or workflow_dispatch, never on push to main.

gates.title: Branch Protection & Required Verify Checks
gates.requirement: Verify workflow must pass cleanly before any merge or release promotion.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Verify CI workflow on GitHub Actions passes with 100% green jobs.

gates.title: Vercel Promotion Gating
gates.requirement: Prevent Vercel production promotion before required verification passes.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Vercel production build corresponds strictly to verified commit SHA.

gates.title: Supabase Exact SHA Deploy
gates.requirement: Supabase production deploy must consume and bind a certified exact commit SHA.
gates.acceptance_criteria: DEPLOYED_COMMIT secret and runtime function metadata match git SHA.

gates.title: Release Fingerprint Across Components
gates.requirement: Create release fingerprint recording release_id, git_sha, frontend_id, edge_sha, worker_sha, migration_head, package_lock_hash.
gates.acceptance_criteria: docs/convergence/RELEASE_MANIFEST.json contains exact multi-component fingerprint.

gates.title: Closure Does Not Invalidate Release Parity (F-01)
gates.requirement: No final documentation commit may invalidate deployed release parity.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Final verified SHA matches currently deployed Vercel and Edge Function SHA identically.

gates.title: Rollback Metadata
gates.requirement: Implement rollback metadata documenting previous frontend deployment, edge release, and schema compatibility.
gates.acceptance_criteria: RELEASE_POLICY.json documents explicit rollback procedures and previous known-good SHAs.

gates.title: Contract Health vs Operational Health Discrimination
gates.requirement: Separate contract error handling from operational service health.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Correctly handling HTTP 503 is labeled contract compliance, not healthy service.

gates.title: Canonical Pure Domain Module
gates.requirement: Create pure TypeScript domain kernel in src/domain/farely/ decoupled from React.
gates.acceptance_criteria: src/domain/farely/ exports core types, entities, and decision algorithms with 0 React dependencies.

gates.title: Canonical TravelIntent Structure
gates.requirement: Canonical TravelIntent representing originScope, destinationScope, journeyType, outbound, inbound, tripLength, passengers, cabin, maxStops, currency.
gates.acceptance_criteria: TravelIntent models both exact dates and flexible windows without field collisions.

gates.title: JourneyType vs MarketScope Separation
gates.requirement: Separate journeyType (ONE_WAY, ROUND_TRIP) from marketScope (DOMESTIC, INTERNATIONAL).
gates.acceptance_criteria: trip_type is never overloaded to mean both roundtrip and domestic/international.

gates.title: LocationScope Architecture
gates.requirement: Support canonical EXACT_AIRPORT, METRO, and NEARBY_SET location scopes.
gates.acceptance_criteria: BKK exact != DMK exact; Bangkok Metro includes both BKK and DMK.

gates.title: Central Airport and Metro Catalog
gates.requirement: Central versioned catalog/resolver containing airport codes, metro memberships, coordinates, and timezones.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Search, Watch, API, and UI resolve city/airport groups through a shared resolver.

gates.title: Money and Pricing Unit Type
gates.requirement: Money type specifying amount, currency, and pricingUnit (PER_TRAVELER, PARTY_TOTAL, OFFER_TOTAL).
gates.acceptance_criteria: Prevents comparing per-traveler fare directly against party total.

gates.title: PassengerMix Capability Gating
gates.requirement: Represent adults, children, infants with explicit capability gating if provider does not support it.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Selecting multiple passengers never silently searches 1 adult without capability disclosure.

gates.title: Cabin Class Propagation
gates.requirement: Cabin selection (ECONOMY, PREMIUM_ECONOMY, BUSINESS, FIRST) propagates to compatible search and Watch.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Business selection does not match Economy offers.

gates.title: Time Contract & UTC/Local Separation
gates.requirement: Separate observedAt (UTC timestamp) from departLocal and arrivalLocal (airport local calendar dates).
gates.acceptance_criteria: Observation date is never mapped into departure date on historical charts.

gates.title: Separated Identity Taxonomy
gates.requirement: Separate TravelIntentId, OfferVariantId, ObservationId, OpportunityId, WatchId, and ConditionEpisodeId.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Each entity has a distinct, typed identifier format.

gates.title: OfferVariantId Excludes Price
gates.requirement: OfferVariantId identity based on itinerary facts (route, carrier, flight, date, cabin), not current price.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Price changing from 3.2M to 2.8M retains the same OfferVariantId.

gates.title: ObservationId Represents Timestamped Event
gates.requirement: ObservationId represents a provider price observation event at time T.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Observations capture variant, observedAt, provider, price, and currency.

gates.title: OpportunityId Represents Decision Aggregate
gates.requirement: OpportunityId represents a decision-level aggregate under a TravelIntent.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Distinct from raw OfferVariant hash.

gates.title: Canonical PriceScopeFingerprint
gates.requirement: One canonical PriceScopeFingerprint used across RouteBest, comparator, Cheaper Alternative, and Watch.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Prevents comparing fares across disparate scope, stops, or cabin dimensions.

gates.title: TravelIntent Round-Trip Property Tests
gates.requirement: Property tests proving TravelIntent survives lossless round-trip serialization across UI, URL, API, DB, Watch, and Saved.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Round-trip property test passes across 50 random generated intent variations.

gates.title: Durable TravelIntent Table
gates.requirement: Introduce public.travel_intents with scope types, codes, dates, passengers, cabin, and currency.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Migration creates travel_intents table with constraints and JSON serialization.

gates.title: Migrate user_alerts to Watch Schema
gates.requirement: Migrate user_alerts toward real Watch schema with distinct attempt, check, and matched timestamp/price semantics.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Columns last_attempt_at, last_successful_check_at, latest_eligible_price, last_matched_price added and populated.

gates.title: Watch Evaluation History Table
gates.requirement: Create public.watch_evaluations recording watch_id, generation_id, timestamps, eligible_count, best_price, status, release_sha.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Table created with foreign keys and status enum (STARTED, SUCCESS, INCOMPLETE, DEGRADED, FAILED).

gates.title: Durable Watch Condition Episodes Table
gates.requirement: Create public.watch_condition_episodes supporting ENTERED, STILL_INSIDE, MATERIAL_IMPROVEMENT, EXITED, REENTERED.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Table tracks opened_at, closed_at, entry_price, best_price, condition state.

gates.title: Transactional Notification Outbox Table
gates.requirement: Create public.notification_outbox with dedupe_key, status (PENDING, PROCESSING, SENT, RETRYABLE_FAILED, PERMANENT_FAILED).
gates.acceptance_criteria: Dedupe key is bound to notification episode/event, not permanent opportunity.

gates.title: Notification Delivery Attempts Table
gates.requirement: Create public.notification_delivery_attempts recording outbox_id, attempt_no, provider, provider_message_id, status, error_code.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Delivery history tracked cleanly across retry attempts.

gates.title: Observed Fare Generations Registry
gates.requirement: Create public.observed_fare_generations tracking state (CANDIDATE, ACTIVE, RETIRED, QUARANTINED), row_count, timestamps, release_sha.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Generation promotion updates state atomically.

gates.title: Reader-Safe Generation Retirement
gates.requirement: Stop deleting previous generations immediately on publish; set retire_after = now + grace window.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Active readers pinned to previous generation do not fail during generation rotation.

gates.title: Long-Lived Normalized Price History
gates.requirement: Normalized evidence used for comparator, 30/90/180-day history persists under documented retention.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Historical records include observedAt, depart/return, OfferVariant identity, cabin, price, provider.

gates.title: Targeted Database Indexes
gates.requirement: Add indexes on active generation + route/date, PriceScope dimensions, outbox pending status.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Indexes exist in migration and support fast query execution.

gates.title: Candidate Generation Integrity Gate
gates.requirement: Candidate generation only publishes if complete according to explicit coverage and integrity policy.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Generations failing integrity checks are marked QUARANTINED and never promoted.

gates.title: Incomplete Candidate Preserves Last-Known-Good
gates.requirement: Incomplete candidate generation never replaces last-known-good active generation.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Previous active generation pointer remains active on crawler failure.

gates.title: Fail Closed on Missing Active Pointer
gates.requirement: If active-generation pointer is missing, return explicit degraded state; never query mixed unpinned generations.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Reader returns degraded_schema rather than unconstrained cross-generation records.

gates.title: Pinned Watch Evaluations
gates.requirement: Watch evaluation must be pinned to one immutable generation throughout its scan.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Evaluator passes generation_id to all candidate queries.

gates.title: Incomplete Query Fails Watch Closed
gates.requirement: If generation disappears or query fails mid-scan, evaluation status = INCOMPLETE (never concluding no match).
gates.acceptance_criteria: Evaluator records INCOMPLETE and does not update lastSuccessfulCheckAt.

gates.title: Snapshot Promotion Concurrency Test
gates.requirement: Concurrency test proving generation promoted mid-scan does not corrupt in-progress Watch evaluation.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Automated test proves in-progress evaluation completes against original generation snapshot.

gates.title: Server-Side .range() Pagination
gates.requirement: Keep actual .range() server-side pagination; do not regress to metadata-only pagination.
gates.acceptance_criteria: observed-fares Edge Function applies .range(start, start + pageSize - 1).

gates.title: Real API Pagination Proof (>=205 Rows)
gates.requirement: Test real API pagination with >=205 rows: P1=60, P2=60, P3=60, P4=25, P5=0, 0 intersection, 100% union.
gates.acceptance_criteria: scripts/pagination-truth.node-test.mjs passes all page size and intersection assertions.

gates.title: Scale Pagination Proof (>1000 Rows)
gates.requirement: Scale pagination test across >1000 rows proving zero duplicate IDs across all pages.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Test verifies 1250 rows across 21 pages with 0 intersection.

gates.title: Global Eligibility Filters Before Pagination
gates.requirement: Every eligibility filter expected to be global executes on database/server before pagination.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Filters for stops, date ranges, region, and price execute in SQL/PostgREST before .range().

gates.title: Deterministic Tie-Breaking
gates.requirement: All sort orders have stable deterministic secondary tie-breaking on id.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Queries append id ASC tie-breaker to prevent pagination jitter.

gates.title: One Production selectRouteBest Engine
gates.requirement: One production selectRouteBest engine used by tests and product alike (no test-local duplicates).
gates.acceptance_criteria: Tests import production module src/domain/farely/routeBest.ts directly.

gates.title: Cheapest = Mathematical Minimum
gates.requirement: Cheapest strictly equals the mathematical minimum valid compatible price within PriceScopeFingerprint.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Function returns lowest price candidate without heuristic alteration.

gates.title: Deal Score Never Overrides Lower Price
gates.requirement: Deal Score must never override a lower compatible price when labeled 'Cheapest'.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Negative control NC-001 passes: lower price always wins Cheapest label.

gates.title: Adversarial Price Truth Fixtures
gates.requirement: Adversarial fixture: eligible offers (4.265M .. 5.30M) vs cheaper ineligible offers (wrong cabin, return, airport, stops).
gates.acceptance_criteria: Engine selects 4.265M direct minimum, discarding cheaper incompatible fares.

gates.title: Input Shuffle Invariance
gates.requirement: Shuffle input array 50 times; route-best price result must never vary.
gates.acceptance_criteria: All 50 permutations yield identical minimum price.

gates.title: Cross-Surface RouteBest Agreement
gates.requirement: Search, Detail, and Watch surfaces must agree on eligible RouteBest calculation.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Shared domain kernel imported across all three feature modules.

gates.title: Global Query Cheaper Alternative
gates.requirement: Remove pageSize 30 + client filtering; query global compatible candidate universe.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Cheaper alternative query executes globally on database/backend.

gates.title: Strict Alternative Compatibility
gates.requirement: Cheaper alternative preserves return date, cabin, passenger mix, stops, and airport scope.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Incompatible flights are excluded from alternative recommendation.

gates.title: Alternative CTA Browser Navigation
gates.requirement: Clicking alternative banner CTA navigates to valid canonical route in real browser.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Playwright E2E clicks alternative CTA and lands on valid canonical detail page.

gates.title: No False Alternative Banner
gates.requirement: If no truly compatible cheaper alternative exists, do not display alternative banner.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Banner condition evaluates strictly to null when deal is already cheapest.

gates.title: One Comparator Implementation
gates.requirement: One comparator implementation across all layers in domain kernel.
gates.acceptance_criteria: src/domain/farely/comparator.ts is single source of comparison logic.

gates.title: Unified Sample Size Thresholds
gates.requirement: Eliminate N>=3 vs N>=5 disagreement; single threshold registry.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Threshold constants defined once in domain kernel and referenced everywhere.

gates.title: Comparable Cohort Dimensions
gates.requirement: Comparable cohort filters on scope, journey type, timing, trip length, stops, cabin, pricing unit, currency.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Offers from different seasons or cabins are excluded from cohort median.

gates.title: Observation Date Isolated From Travel Date
gates.requirement: Observation date must never become travel date. Typed historical observations separate time T from departure.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Regression test NC-007 passes: observation in October for flight in December never plots October as travel date.

gates.title: Evidence Level Classification
gates.requirement: Evidence levels (INSUFFICIENT, WEAK, MODERATE, STRONG) map to explicit sample size, independent epochs, and freshness.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Deal with N < 3 samples explicitly labeled INSUFFICIENT with no discount claim.

gates.title: No Pseudo-Probability Confidence
gates.requirement: No fake confidence percentages; use evidence categories unless statistically calibrated.
gates.acceptance_criteria: UI displays qualitative evidence tier ('Đang tích lũy', 'Đầy đủ bằng chứng') rather than raw fake 92%.

gates.title: Historical Lowest Claim Requires Proof
gates.requirement: Historical 'lowest' claim requires compatible cohort evidence spanning multiple epochs.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Label 'Thấp nhất lịch sử' only rendered when independent epoch criteria met.

gates.title: Consume providedHiddenCosts
gates.requirement: Fix evaluateTrueCost so passed known costs are actually consumed and incorporated into total.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Passing providedHiddenCosts overrides or augments default component calculations.

gates.title: Epistemic Cost Component Breakdown
gates.requirement: Represent cost components as KNOWN, ESTIMATED, OPTIONAL, UNKNOWN with currency and evidence.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Each cost component carries explicit epistemic status and disclosure text.

gates.title: Unknown Mandatory Cost != Zero
gates.requirement: Unknown mandatory cost must not be converted to 0; labeled explicitly as 'Chưa rõ'.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Negative control NC-033 passes: missing cost component renders 'Chưa rõ', not 0₫.

gates.title: Heuristic Baggage Not Called Real Total
gates.requirement: Do not label heuristic airline-wide baggage estimate as 'Tổng thực tế'.
gates.acceptance_criteria: UI shows 'Tối thiểu đã biết' plus 'Phụ phí ước tính'.

gates.title: Taxes Included Claim Proven by Source
gates.requirement: No universal 'taxes & mandatory fees included' claim unless source contract proves it.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Taxes included flag derives from provider metadata (e.g. Vietjet all-in quote).

gates.title: Fare Family Baggage Priority
gates.requirement: Prefer provider-derived fare family baggage data over airline-wide heuristic when available.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Engine checks offer-specific baggage allowance before falling back to airline rule.

gates.title: Search Constructs Canonical TravelIntent
gates.requirement: Home and Search composer construct actual canonical TravelIntent with all dimensions.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Search form serializes to canonical intent URL parameters.

gates.title: Separate Departure Range from Round-Trip Return
gates.requirement: Fix semantic collision: departureFrom/departureTo must not simultaneously mean departure window and return date.
gates.acceptance_criteria: distinct params departDateFrom/departDateTo vs returnDateFrom/returnDateTo.

gates.title: Cabin Visible Control Propagates
gates.requirement: Visible cabin control must actually propagate to backend query or be disabled.
gates.acceptance_criteria: NC-021 passes: changing cabin to Business queries business class offers.

gates.title: Passenger Visible Control Propagates
gates.requirement: Visible passenger control must actually propagate to backend query or be disabled.
gates.acceptance_criteria: NC-022 passes: passenger count affects party total calculation.

gates.title: Canonical Airport/City Picker
gates.requirement: Airport/city picker stores structured entity (code, scopeType, metroId), not raw string only.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Selecting Bangkok (All) stores metro scope; selecting Suvarnabhumi stores exact BKK.

gates.title: Server-Side Metro Scope Expansion
gates.requirement: Metro scope expands server-side: BKK_METRO queries both BKK and DMK.
gates.acceptance_criteria: NC-003 passes: BKK_METRO search returns DMK flights.

gates.title: Typed Search Error States
gates.requirement: Expose HEALTHY_RESULTS, HEALTHY_EMPTY, OUT_OF_COVERAGE, PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE, TIMEOUT, RATE_LIMITED.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Search status envelope includes status code, query, and message.

gates.title: Provider Failure Never Masquerades as Empty
gates.requirement: Provider failure never becomes 'Không tìm thấy chuyến bay'; explicit retry CTA shown.
gates.acceptance_criteria: NC-011 passes: provider 500/503 renders error retry card, not empty inventory.

gates.title: Search Coverage Disclosure
gates.requirement: Search exposes coverage truth (e.g. monitored routes vs unmonitored).
gates.acceptance_criteria: User searching unmonitored route receives informative coverage message.

gates.title: Watch Stores Canonical TravelIntent
gates.requirement: Watch creation accepts and stores complete canonical TravelIntent with all constraints.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Watch record links to or embeds full TravelIntent JSON.

gates.title: Detail to Watch Intent Preservation
gates.requirement: Detail -> Watch passes full Opportunity TravelIntent (route, dates, cabin, stops, price).
gates.acceptance_criteria: Opening Watch modal from detail page pre-fills exact opportunity criteria.

gates.title: Search to Watch Intent Preservation
gates.requirement: Search -> Watch passes full Search TravelIntent without stripping filters.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Creating watch from search results preserves all active search constraints.

gates.title: No Hidden Default Route
gates.requirement: Remove hidden default HAN->BKK submission when user has not chosen it.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Watch modal without context requires user to select origin and destination explicitly.

gates.title: Round-Trip Return Semantics Exact
gates.requirement: Round-trip return semantics exact; missing return date cannot match explicit round-trip Watch.
gates.acceptance_criteria: NC-006 passes: one-way flight or missing return date rejected by round-trip watch.

gates.title: Persist Journey Type on Watch
gates.requirement: Persist journey_type on Watch database record and evaluate accordingly.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Watch table stores journey_type column; matcher enforces it.

gates.title: Persist Scope & Constraints on Watch
gates.requirement: Persist cabin, passengers, currency, location scope on Watch record.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Matcher evaluates cabin and stops constraints stored in database.

gates.title: Server Authoritative Authenticated Watch
gates.requirement: Authenticated Watch state is server-authoritative; local storage is cache/offline aid only.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Authenticated user loads watches directly from Supabase DB via RLS.

gates.title: No Stale Local Union
gates.requirement: Do not union stale local Watch into authenticated remote truth blindly.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Logging in syncs local to remote only on explicit user confirmation or replaces cache.

gates.title: Watch Mutation Rollback on Server Error
gates.requirement: Watch pause/resume/delete server failure must rollback optimistic state or show sync_failed.
gates.acceptance_criteria: NC-016 passes: failed remote pause rolls back UI toggle to active.

gates.title: Scoped Indexed Watch Matching
gates.requirement: Replace Cartesian full-scan with route/date scoped matching against active generation.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Matcher queries watches indexed to published generation route/date scope.

gates.title: Page Failure Fails Evaluation Closed
gates.requirement: Any query/page failure during Watch evaluation marks evaluation INCOMPLETE.
gates.acceptance_criteria: NC-009 passes: truncated evaluation does not conclude no-match.

gates.title: Separate Check and Matched Timestamps
gates.requirement: Separate lastAttemptAt, lastSuccessfulCheckAt, lastMatchedAt.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Watch record maintains all three distinct timestamps.

gates.title: Separate Observed, Eligible, Matched Prices
gates.requirement: Separate latestObservedPrice, latestEligiblePrice, lastMatchedPrice.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Non-matching observed price does not overwrite lastMatchedPrice.

gates.title: Durable Condition Episodes
gates.requirement: Model condition episodes: OUTSIDE, ENTERED, STILL_INSIDE, MATERIAL_IMPROVEMENT, EXITED, REENTERED.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Watch episode state machine handles price movements across boundary.

gates.title: Price Leaves Target Transitions to EXITED
gates.requirement: Price leaves target -> episode transitions to EXITED (no sticky stale match).
gates.acceptance_criteria: NC-017 passes: price rising above target closes condition episode.

gates.title: Re-Entry Opens New Episode
gates.requirement: Price re-entering target opens new eligible condition episode.
gates.acceptance_criteria: NC-018 passes: price dropping back below target triggers REENTERED.

gates.title: Material Improvement Re-Alert
gates.requirement: Material additional price decrease inside condition is eligible for re-alert policy.
gates.acceptance_criteria: NC-019 passes: 10%+ further price drop inside episode emits new alert.

gates.title: Expired Travel Windows Expire Watch
gates.requirement: Expired travel departure date marks Watch EXPIRED and stops evaluation.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Evaluator marks watches with depart_date < today as expired.

gates.title: Scheduler Heartbeat Proven
gates.requirement: Scheduler heartbeat tracks scheduled_at, started_at, completed_at, release, watches_evaluated, errors.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Heartbeat records persisted to database and verifiable via API.

gates.title: Anonymous Watch Integrity
gates.requirement: Anonymous Watch implements email + Turnstile + confirmation or clearly requires auth.
gates.acceptance_criteria: UI requires email and Turnstile token before accepting anonymous watch.

gates.title: Transactional Notification Outbox
gates.requirement: Implement transactional outbox architecture for notifications.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Notification records written to outbox table inside business transaction.

gates.title: Outbox Precedes Side Effect
gates.requirement: Watch evaluation transaction writes notification intent before third-party external side effect.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Zero network side effects executed inside evaluation database transaction.

gates.title: Outbox Delivery Worker
gates.requirement: Delivery worker processes pending outbox entries asynchronously.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Worker queries status=PENDING, delivers, and updates status=SENT.

gates.title: Bounded Retry Backoff
gates.requirement: Retry transient delivery failures with bounded exponential backoff (1m, 5m, 15m).
gates.acceptance_criteria: Retry policy calculates exact backoff schedule and caps at maximum attempts.

gates.title: Idempotency Key Per Notification Event
gates.requirement: Unique dedupe_key corresponds to notification event, not permanent opportunity.
gates.acceptance_criteria: NC-020 passes: duplicate scheduler invocation produces identical dedupe_key and sends once.

gates.title: Re-Alert on New Episode / Material Improvement
gates.requirement: Same opportunity can re-alert under new condition episode or material price drop.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Evaluator checks episode status and price delta before deduplicating.

gates.title: Channel Respect Discipline
gates.requirement: Respect selected notification channel; user selecting Telegram does not receive unwanted email.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Dispatcher routes strictly to channels configured on Watch record.

gates.title: Provider Delivery ID & Status Storage
gates.requirement: Store external provider message IDs (Resend ID, Telegram message ID) and delivery status.
gates.acceptance_criteria: delivery_attempts table records provider ID and HTTP status code.

gates.title: Detection to Delivery Latency Tracking
gates.requirement: Measure detection to delivery latency across outbox lifecycle.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Log and record duration between outbox created_at and sent_at.

gates.title: Authenticated Saved Remote Authority
gates.requirement: Authenticated Saved opportunities are server-authoritative via Supabase DB.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Bookmarks for authenticated users sync directly to user_saved_opportunities.

gates.title: Anonymous Saved Local Allowed
gates.requirement: Anonymous Saved allows local browser storage.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Unauthenticated user saves items to localStorage without requiring login.

gates.title: Explicit Login Merge Flow
